rules.description: Validate source scope, dates, previous bank close and opening/lines/closing arithmetic before matching.

provenance.note: Source concept; strict input schema, bounded units and rejection behavior are sample engineering policy.

rules.description: Require explicit account-specific mapping and date windows.

provenance.note: Two calendar days, fixed offset and exact sign declaration are configurable fictional choices.

rules.description: Review multiple candidates rather than silently taking the first match.

provenance.note: Uses the source's manual-review approach; does not claim its default is ambiguity-safe.

rules.description: Reserve exact manifest members before singles, require one bank claim, full availability, same type/date and exact signed sum.

provenance.note: No subset-sum inference or failed-batch fallback.

rules.description: Build all single candidate edges simultaneously; only isolated one-bank/one-ledger components become candidate pairs.

provenance.note: Entire nontrivial connected components remain ambiguous; no greedy/date/amount tie-break.

rules.description: Report tolerated single deltas as pending corrections, never ledger updates.

provenance.note: Product penny-difference context only; corpus never posts corrections.

rules.description: Classify explicit expected clearing inside the configured post-cutoff grace; mark other unmatched aged ledger rows stale only above threshold.

provenance.note: Calendar-day timing is fictional and does not prove clearing.

rules.description: Partition all eligible rows exactly once and explain closing difference with opening difference, signed unmatched amounts and matched deltas.

provenance.note: An arithmetic bridge plus a pending controller packet is not an actual bank reconciliation sign-off.

steps.title: Load synthetic exports
steps.procedure: Read supplied JSON source counts and explicit control/as-of/cutoff. Do not fetch financial data.

steps.title: Validate source integrity and closes
steps.procedure: Reject malformed keys/types/configuration or contradictory scopes/close arithmetic before financial output.

steps.title: Normalize signs, dates and scope
steps.procedure: Normalize headers and lines together, apply fixed-offset business dates, and visibly exclude ineligible ledger extras.

steps.title: Join manifests and single candidates
steps.procedure: Reserve manifests and construct complete account/reference/type/date/amount candidate sets before assigning any pair.

steps.title: Select isolated candidate groups
steps.procedure: Accept exact eligible manifest groups and isolated single edges only; display delta and never write back.

steps.title: Route every unresolved item
steps.procedure: Explain ambiguity, incomplete batches, unmapped codes, mismatches, fees, timing and staleness with deterministic reasons.

steps.title: Build signed close bridge
steps.procedure: Add opening difference, unmatched bank minus unmatched ledger, and matched deltas; verify equality to closing difference per currency scope.

steps.title: Emit controller review packet
steps.procedure: Return every row, candidate set, group, exclusion and bridge plus pending/no-live-action review. No posting or real approval.
